command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/out
python3 -u /tmp/fetch.py /tmp/out > /tmp/out/db.sha256 2> /tmp/out/fetch.log
RC=$?
cat /tmp/out/db.sha256 /tmp/out/fetch.log
[ $RC = 0 ] || { echo "FAIL: fetch exit $RC"; exit 1; }
echo DONE
